[[Brett]] is an [[Armorer]] for the [[Ebon Vanguard]]. He only offers his services for players who have attained the rank of [[Ebon Vanguard rank|Shadow Agent]].

==Locations==
*[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Eye of the North (outpost)}}

==Dialogue==
Before attaining rank 5 on the Ebon Vanguard title track:
:''You are no exception to our rules, <character name>. Every man, woman, and child must prove his or her worth to the cause before benefiting from our services. So, until you obtain the rank of Shadow Agent, please move along. You must understand that we haven't survived this long against the Charr by giving our supplies away to every Tom, Dick, and Teardrinker who passes through here.''

After attaining rank 5 or higher on the Ebon Vanguard title track:
